SELECT event_id, event_time, src_hostname, process_name, file_path, hash_sha256, user_name, class_uid, activity_id, action, outcome FROM aisoc.raw_events
WHERE tenant_id = '53824f24-d1d4-5820-8147-f6cfda8a1247' AND src_hostname = 'INV-R11-FULL-RAW-01'
AND event_time >= toDateTime64('2026-10-31 16:00:00.000000', 6, 'UTC')
AND event_time < toDateTime64('2026-10-31 16:04:00.000000', 6, 'UTC') AND class_uid = 1007 AND process_name != ''
ORDER BY event_time, event_id LIMIT 21
